correctness.rationale: Given nonempty independent fibers and complete lifted edges, the section s is a digraph map and pi*s=id_G. With q=s*tau*pi, the forward arcs x->q(x) and s*pi(x)->q(x) are present for each x; each gives a valid one-step line-digraph homotopy, hence s*pi~id_B. This proves all-parameter homotopy equivalence, not just sampled homology. For an oriented n-cycle (n>=3) the only nonzero integral path-homology groups are H0=H1=Z: the cycle edge sum generates ker(d1), while deletion of the second vertex of an allowed k>=2 path creates a unique forbidden skip, so Omega_k=0. Verified definitions/normalization. The source finite verification is supportive, but its claimed direct n=3..12 skip test is actually a tautological assert n-1==n-1; no inferential weight assigned to that line.
residual_risks: Scientific scope explicitly uses edge-collapse-allowed digraph maps and the standard line homotopy, not strict arc-preserving maps.
